truth_policy.MEDIA: No public image without rights and privacy approval, feature binding scope is explicit
truth_policy.DRIVING: Conceptual, explicitly SIMULATED; no real traffic, GNSS route, speed or guaranteed lawful access
truth_policy.ONLINE_MAPS: API credentialed online SDK, coverage/billing/network required; not bundled or verified in headless QA
truth_policy.FAST_GAME: Public law zone radii cited; emitters, waveforms, distance cases and interference levels are educational simulations, not live measurements
truth_policy.V10_TRAVEL: verified road names and connection directions only; no end-to-end navigable road topology; game stage positions simulated
